summary: Validated P0 frontend router refactor. All critical routes tested: landing/home page loads without blank screen, /login and /register routes work correctly, admin login and admin routes (/admin, /admin/customers) accessible, /taxi and /mobility-center routes render properly, special routes (/pay/:token, /table/:tableId, /order/qr/:id) do not crash, KYC-restricted routes redirect unverified users appropriately, bottom navigation and BackToHomeBar shell behavior work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Router refactor successfully extracted path utils, admin route tab map, app shell flag logic, and special route rendering into separate files without breaking any user-facing routes.
The extracted modules (pathUtils.js, adminRouteMap.js, appShellFlags.js, renderSpecialRoutes.jsx) are well-structured and follow single-responsibility principle.
KYC-restricted path checking is correctly implemented in pathUtils.js with proper prefix matching.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A - This was a stability/refactor validation, not a bug fix. The refactor successfully reduced App.js complexity by extracting path utilities, admin route mapping, app shell flag logic, and special route rendering into separate modules.
